posts.title: Byte Magazine’s “Technological Breakthrough” Cover Re-created As a Photograph
posts.description: I’ve been re-creating Robert Tinney’s Byte magazine paintings as photographs. My latest work is “Technological Breakthrough”. Byte’s January 1986 issue had a focus on robotics. Mr. Tinney painted a robot claw hatching out of an egg. As I’ve done with several other Byte covers, I re-created Tinney’s vision as if it were real, and as if a photographer had been standing next to Tinney as he painted.
